name: Waldo County, ME
findings: Waldo County has 155 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Waldo County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few religious organizations list public events
observations.text: 1 religious organization here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 6 hobby and sports organizations here list membership, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
